name: scope

findings.message: Adding `timed_out` to `_pipeline_status_glyph` and `_pipeline_status_color` also re-aligned every other case arm (widening the padding on `complete|success`, `complete_unconverged`, `failed|interrupted|aborted`, and `preflight_failed`) — these lines were not required to change and represent minor style drift beyond the strict feature requirement.

The awk pattern for extracting `_startup_term` was tightened from `/trap .* TERM$/` to `/trap '.*' TERM$/` to prevent false-positive matching against the new `trap ':' INT TERM` guard lines placed inside `_runner_abort_trap` (a nested function inside `main()`); this is defensive test maintenance triggered by the feature rather than a new assertion about the feature's own behaviour.

reason: the scope lens found no high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
